task.text:
[0] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

[1] AKT2 knockout in mice promoted aging-induced cardiac hypertrophy but rescued aging-induced changes in Ca signaling and functioning of cardiomyocytes. Aging-dependent downregulation of SIRT1 and phosphorylation of FOXO1 and AKT were partially compensated by AKT2 knockout.

[2] Knockdown of akt-1 significantly prolonged the lifespan of worms and resulted in decreased expression of ribosomal genes and reduction of mitochondrial DNA. Nematodes at the L4 stage were transferred to RNAi bacterial plates in the presence of 1 mM isopropyl β-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG), 25 mg/ml carbenicillin and 5-fluoro-20-deoxyuridine (FUdR, 0.5 mg/ml). L1 period as t = 0 for lifespan analysis.

[3] Age was counted from the L1 stage. 1 mM isopropyl b-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG), 25 mg/ml carbenicillin and 0.5 mg/ml 5-fluoro-20-deoxyuridine (FUdR) were added to the culture medium.

[4] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

[5] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

[6] Overexpression of Akt promoted early death in flies. In contrast, downregulation of Akt by RNAi showed no effect on longevity.

[7] Knockdown of akt-1 significantly prolonged the lifespan of worms and resulted in decreased expression of ribosomal genes and reduction of mitochondrial DNA. Nematodes at the L4 stage were transferred to RNAi bacterial plates in the presence of 1 mM isopropyl β-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG), 25 mg/ml carbenicillin and 5-fluoro-20-deoxyuridine (FUdR, 0.5 mg/ml). L1 period as t = 0 for lifespan analysis.

[8] Age was counted from the L1 stage. 1 mM isopropyl b-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG), 25 mg/ml carbenicillin and 0.5 mg/ml 5-fluoro-20-deoxyuridine (FUdR) were added to the culture medium.

[9] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
